data.rationale: The proposal follows the true flow (OpenTable search, restaurant details, Allrecipes search, recipe time, note) with the right parameters and note template, but it leaves out the 4+ star recipe criterion, the "do not click a time slot or Reserve" constraint and the "New note" click, and it says "top recipe" and "a restaurant result" where the true workflow says first restaurant. It also doesn't name the tabs, so an automation would have to guess some details.
